publisher: North Yorkshire Council / former Hambleton District Council
evidence_slice: North Yorkshire Council's Hambleton Local Plan allocates NOR1, Winton Road, Northallerton, a 31.4ha site for approximately 485 homes (650 gross), land for a one-form-entry primary school, open space, green infrastructure and an internal link road. The 2024-25 Hambleton Local Plan Area Authority Monitoring Report records NOR1 with potential capacity 650 and zero completions at 31 March 2025, with status 'Outline / Phase 1 - Reserved Matters'; outline application 20/01687/OUT and Phase 1 reserved-matters application ZB24/01785/REM are cited. North Yorkshire Council's public PlanningPolicy MapServer layer 2 is 'Housing Allocations', an esriGeometryPolygon layer exposing allocation-reference, address, area and potential-yield fields.
binding_method: adopted Local Plan allocation plus current authority monitoring record plus authority-hosted Housing Allocations polygon MapServer; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: The official Local Plan, authority-monitoring report and GIS service were accessed through public web transport; raw source-file bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.
